question: What supreme forms does māyā bear according to this teaching?
premises: Māyā bears the form of brahman
Māyā bears the form of will
inference: Supreme māyā bears both the form of brahman and the form of will.
uncertainties: brahma-rūpadharā may indicate identity with or manifestation as brahman
plain_english: Māyā indeed bears the form of brahman and, as supreme, bears the form of will.
